# SF Tree Removal

> SF Tree Removal is an online service that connects South Florida property owners with independent local tree care professionals. A visitor describes the tree (removal, emergency storm cleanup, trimming, stump grinding or an arborist assessment). The service is active in Fort Lauderdale and the surrounding area, where an independent professional contacts the visitor with a free estimate; elsewhere in Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach County professionals are being added, so requests are matched where possible with no promise of a response. The site publishes local guides, permit rules and costs for 28 cities in the three counties. SF Tree Removal does not perform tree work itself, and has no office or crews; the professional agrees scope, price and schedule directly with the customer.

## Requests

- [Tree Removal](https://sftreeremoval.com/tree-removal/): estimates for large, dead, leaning and storm-damaged trees, palms and stumps
- [Emergency Tree Removal](https://sftreeremoval.com/emergency-tree-removal/): urgent requests for fallen and hazardous trees, flagged for local professionals (no guaranteed arrival time)
- [Tree Trimming](https://sftreeremoval.com/tree-trimming/): trimming, pruning and palm trimming, and what to avoid (topping)
- [Stump Grinding](https://sftreeremoval.com/stump-grinding/): grinding versus removal, depth and what to ask for
- [Free Tree Removal](https://sftreeremoval.com/free-tree-removal/): what is actually free (estimates, public trees, insurance, assistance programs) and how to pay less
- [All tree services](https://sftreeremoval.com/tree-services/): overview of every service
- [Arborist Assessments](https://sftreeremoval.com/certified-arborist/): tree health and risk reports, including documentation for permits and insurance
